policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="requestBody" value="@{
            try
            {
                return context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }" />

        
            <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestBody") == null)">
                
                    
                    
                        application/json
                    
                    {"error":"invalid_request","message":"Request body must be valid JSON."}
                
            
            <when condition="@(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestBody")["text"]))">
                
                    
                    
                        application/json
                    
                    {"error":"invalid_request","message":"A non-empty 'text' field is required."}
                
            
        

        
        <set-variable name="ttsText" value="@{
            var body = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestBody");
            var text = (string)body["text"];
            // XML/HTML-escape the text before embedding it in the SSML body below.
            // System.Security.SecurityElement.Escape is NOT supported in APIM policy expressions;
            // System.Net.WebUtility.HtmlEncode is supported and produces valid XML-safe output
            // (& < > " ').
            return System.Net.WebUtility.HtmlEncode(text);
        }" />
        <set-variable name="ttsVoice" value="@{
            var body = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestBody");
            var voice = (string)body["voice"];
            return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(voice) ? "en-US-JennyNeural" : voice;
        }" />
        <set-variable name="ttsLanguage" value="@{
            var body = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestBody");
            var lang = (string)body["language"];
            return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(lang) ? "en-US" : lang;
        }" />
        <set-variable name="ttsOutputFormat" value="@{
            var body = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestBody");
            var fmt = (string)body["outputFormat"];
            return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fmt) ? "riff-24khz-16bit-mono-pcm" : fmt;
        }" />

        
        @{
            string ssml = "<speak version='1.0' xml:lang='" + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ttsLanguage") + "'>" +
                          "<voice xml:lang='" + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ttsLanguage") + "' name='" + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ttsVoice") + "'>" +
                          context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ttsText") +
                          "";
            return ssml;
        }

        
        

        
        

        
        
            @("Bearer aad#" + "{{speech-resource-id}}" + "#" + (string)context.Variables["speech-access-token"])
        

        
        
            application/ssml+xml
        
        
            @((string)context.Variables["ttsOutputFormat"])
        
        
            apim-speech-demo
        

        POST
